tool: Video Rebirth BACH (BACH 1.0 Pro / BACH 1.0 Preview)
event: BACH 1.0 Pro advances to #3 Artificial Analysis Image-to-Video leaderboard
classification_note: Cannot call Strong Specialist or Category Leader below confidence B. Strong leaderboard signal warrants first look and outreach. Hands-on test required before upgrade.

criteria.name: Product specificity (solves a defined use case)
criteria.notes: Multi-shot reference-guided generation (Element2Video, montage2video endpoints) directly solves product-specific affiliate clip use case. Reference image input confirmed in API docs. 6pts unresolved: whether product ASIN identity survives generation at AIVP standard (first-10s pass/fail) requires hands-on test.

criteria.name: Output quality (resolution, coherence, usability)
criteria.notes: Native 1080p 30fps claim made in official press release and product page. #3 Artificial Analysis Image-to-Video Elo (unverified exact score for Pro version; Preview Elo ~1215 confirmed via crafiq.ai). 6pts unresolved: Pro quality improvement vs Preview unverified without direct AIVP test run.

criteria.name: Workflow strength (ease of input → output)
criteria.notes: API documented with clear endpoints. Free credits on sign-up lowers barrier. Montage feature: upload reference images + text prompt → multi-shot output. 6pts unresolved: actual latency, UI friction, error rate, and reference-image workflow usability untested by AIVP.

criteria.name: Control & consistency (repeatable quality)
criteria.notes: Character lock across shots is architecture-first claim (PNA). Recursive Self-Improvement post-training methodology described. 5pts unresolved: cannot verify consistency across 3 identical runs without hands-on testing.

criteria.name: Speed & reliability (render time, error rate)
criteria.notes: No render timing data available. API region is 'na' endpoint; latency for AU creators unknown. Error rate unknown.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency (cost per usable output)
criteria.notes: Free sign-up credits confirmed (pr@videorebirth.com and product page). Pricing page 404 — per-video/per-second cost unknown. Cannot calculate cost per usable output until pricing is accessible.

criteria.name: Commercial rights (YouTube monetizable, reusable?)
criteria.notes: No commercial use terms or content license found on bach.art or videorebirth.com as of 2026-09-16. Press kit download requires agreement to 'legitimate press purposes only' — this is press kit terms, not generation output terms. Commercial rights not verified; critical for AIVP affiliate content and YouTube monetization.

criteria.name: Automation & integration (API, webhooks, MCP-ready?)
criteria.notes: REST API documented with text2video, image2video, montage2video, element2video endpoints. Callback support documented. Auth via Bearer token. MCP integration feasible. Full marks on this criterion from documentation alone.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit (accessible to Australian indie creators?)
criteria.notes: Singapore-based company; global access expected. Free credits on sign-up. API endpoint is 'api-gen-na' (North America) — AU latency and payment method unverified.

criteria.name: Monetization fit (works for affiliate/sponsorship/AdSense?)
criteria.notes: No affiliate program found on site. Not on any known network (Rewardful, Impact, PartnerStack, ShareASale). Affiliate details requested in outreach.

analysis: BACH 1.0 Pro's advance to #3 on Artificial Analysis I2V leaderboard via Recursive Self-Improvement is a credible leaderboard signal. The multi-shot Montage feature with reference-image input directly maps to AIVP's product-specific affiliate video use case. The REST API is documented and integration-ready. Key unknowns are commercial output rights (critical, unverified) and pricing (page 404). Cannot call Strong Specialist or higher until AIVP completes at least one controlled hands-on run and confirms commercial use terms.
confidence_notes: Confidence C: leaderboard benchmark data (independent third-party, credible), official press releases, product page, and API docs. No AIVP-run artifacts. BACH 1.0 Pro not yet live; scoring based on Preview + Pro announcement.
next_step: Vendor outreach for commercial rights confirmation and trial access. Monitor end-of-September 2026 for Pro launch. Run case study on free credits.
